title: The Static of Halcyon Drift Again
author: Zephyrine Crane
blurb: Edmund Yarrow, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the fleet's truce expires.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
